title: Finish a bounded support loop
objective: Implement action/observation transitions and validated completion.
adversarial_case: Malformed completion and a model that never terminates.

title: Dispatch only registered actions
objective: Route a structured action to an allowlisted handler.
adversarial_case: Unknown tool and malicious argument expression.

title: Turn a tool failure into usable state
objective: Translate tool exceptions into typed observations without losing progress.
adversarial_case: Timeout followed by a successful independent action.

title: Stop before the seventh action
objective: Enforce a six-action ceiling with an explicit terminal status.
adversarial_case: No final response at the budget boundary.

title: Compact state without losing the current task
objective: Compress older observations and preserve active constraints.
adversarial_case: Summary drops a required approval or unresolved question.

title: Publish a callable tool contract
objective: Derive a JSON schema for a supported Python signature.
adversarial_case: Unsupported annotation must fail clearly.

title: Separate missing and nullable parameters
objective: Translate supported annotations and defaults into parameter metadata.
adversarial_case: Optional value with no default versus default None.

title: Reject invalid action arguments
objective: Validate shape, types, ranges and extra fields before dispatch.
adversarial_case: Boolean accepted accidentally as an integer.

title: Collect parallel results without losing identity
objective: Preserve call IDs and deterministic presentation order.
adversarial_case: Duplicate tool names with different call IDs and one failure.

title: Give every observation a stable envelope
objective: Normalize strings, objects and errors into a typed result envelope.
adversarial_case: Nested exception text contains a synthetic credential.

title: Fit recent turns around a pinned policy
objective: Keep complete recent turns inside a context budget.
adversarial_case: Pinned policy alone exceeds the budget.

title: Carry unresolved work across compaction
objective: Summarize removed turns while retaining provenance and open issues.
adversarial_case: An unresolved issue exists only in the oldest turn.

title: Reconcile customer facts by trust and recency
objective: Resolve duplicate and conflicting records with explicit source rank.
adversarial_case: A newer untrusted record contradicts a verified record.

title: Protect task constraints during eviction
objective: Evict low-priority context without losing active obligations.
adversarial_case: All remaining records are mandatory and cannot fit.

title: Choose useful evidence without repetition
objective: Rerank candidates using relevance and source diversity.
adversarial_case: Top results duplicate one paragraph and omit the answer.

title: Keep an answer intact across chunk boundaries
objective: Split documents with stable source offsets and controlled overlap.
adversarial_case: The answer straddles two paragraphs at a size boundary.

title: Attach a source to each evidence block
objective: Build bounded context with stable citation IDs.
adversarial_case: Repeated source names and a truncated chunk.

title: Abstain when evidence is too weak
objective: Apply a published evidence threshold and empty-result policy.
adversarial_case: No result reaches the threshold.

title: Normalize answers without accepting leakage
objective: Apply documented normalization while rejecting internal artifacts.
adversarial_case: Correct answer wrapped in a leaked tool transcript.

title: Score outcome and behavior separately
objective: Compute rubric dimensions and retain failure reasons.
adversarial_case: A correct answer follows an unauthorized action.

title: Execute a dependent action plan
objective: Resolve dependencies and carry typed outputs between steps.
adversarial_case: A failed prerequisite blocks only its dependents.

title: Bind approval to an exact action
objective: Require approval for a specific action version, actor and expiry.
adversarial_case: Arguments change after approval is granted.

title: Choose a model within hard constraints
objective: Select from supplied cost, quality and latency metadata.
adversarial_case: No candidate satisfies all constraints.

title: Coordinate workers with one global budget
objective: Schedule capable workers while honoring dependencies and quotas.
adversarial_case: One worker consumes the budget needed by another.

title: Answer from evidence through a guarded workflow
objective: Combine authorized retrieval, bounded tools and supported answers.
adversarial_case: A retrieved document tells the agent to reveal another tenant's data.

title: Integrate a deployable agent control loop
objective: Compose planning, state, permissions, execution and auditable results.
adversarial_case: Cancellation arrives between approval and tool execution.

title: Check action policy before execution
objective: Enforce allowlists and explicit constraints outside the model.
adversarial_case: Blocked request hidden in nested JSON; benign quoted attack text.

title: Record a redacted execution timeline
objective: Create stable correlated events with durations and terminal status.
adversarial_case: Secrets and unbounded payloads in error messages.

title: Locate the first failing transition
objective: Detect repetition, invalid state and latency bottlenecks.
adversarial_case: Later errors distract from an earlier broken prerequisite.

title: Retry a transient failure within a deadline
objective: Apply bounded exponential delay, jitter and a total deadline.
adversarial_case: Next backoff would exceed the remaining deadline.

title: Switch tools only when policy permits
objective: Classify failures and apply safe retry or fallback rules.
adversarial_case: Authentication failure must not trigger a broader-privilege fallback.

title: Build a source-preserving research workflow
objective: Compose search, extraction and synthesis with partial results.
adversarial_case: Extraction succeeds for only one of three sources.

title: Retrieve memories with stable ranking
objective: Select relevant authorized memories with deterministic ties.
adversarial_case: Equally ranked records from different tenants.

title: Expire context without abandoning active work
objective: Apply expiry rules and preserve live task dependencies.
adversarial_case: A pinned but legally deleted record must not survive.

title: Resolve a follow-up without changing intent
objective: Rewrite an ambiguous query using authorized conversation context.
adversarial_case: The prior turn refers to a different customer or product.

title: Deliver a grounded support answer end to end
objective: Rewrite, retrieve, cite and abstain with explicit evidence checks.
adversarial_case: Conflicting policy versions and insufficient evidence.

title: Fuse lexical and semantic rankings
objective: Deduplicate and rank two result lists by a published fusion rule.
adversarial_case: Missing ranks, duplicate IDs and deterministic ties.

title: Evaluate instruction-boundary failures
objective: Build a labeled evaluator for attempted instruction overrides.
adversarial_case: Quoted security training text versus an active override attempt.

title: Check trace invariants across valid paths
objective: Evaluate required precedence and forbidden events rather than one exact path.
adversarial_case: Two valid tool orders should both pass.

title: Report variability across repeated trials
objective: Aggregate per-case trial outcomes and show unstable slices.
adversarial_case: Missing trials and a best-of-run result that hides failures.

title: Explain failure categories without exposing answers
objective: Generate useful category-level feedback from trusted evaluator records.
adversarial_case: A hidden input contains text asking to print the expected answer.

title: Review a proposal against delivery constraints
objective: Score architecture decisions against an explicit client brief.
adversarial_case: Technically elegant design violates budget or operating ownership.

title: Prioritize repairs from config and trace evidence
objective: Combine observed failures into a ranked remediation plan.
adversarial_case: A plausible hypothesis contradicts recorded events.

title: Complete an evidence-only system prompt
objective: Fill policy slots for sources, abstention and output shape.
adversarial_case: Source text asks the model to ignore the policy.

title: Remove one unsafe promise
objective: Delete only the word always from a specified policy clause.
adversarial_case: Other occurrences of always in examples must remain unchanged.

title: Repair an invalid JSON response
objective: Return a schema-valid object without invented fields.
adversarial_case: Markdown fences, trailing commas and missing required keys.

title: Separate instructions from customer text
objective: Build a typed message envelope that labels untrusted data.
adversarial_case: Customer text contains fake system-role delimiters.

title: Fit a response inside a token allowance
objective: Allocate input and output budgets using a supplied tokenizer.
adversarial_case: Multilingual text uses more tokens than a character heuristic predicts.

title: Choose examples that teach the boundary
objective: Select representative few-shot examples from a labeled set.
adversarial_case: All selected examples belong to one class.

title: Extract a support ticket without guessing
objective: Populate typed fields and mark unknown values explicitly.
adversarial_case: Customer text contradicts itself about an order ID.

title: Add the missing boundary test
objective: Write a test for the empty-evidence path.
adversarial_case: Only the happy path has been tested.

title: Repair a contradictory system prompt
objective: Resolve competing rules while preserving valid obligations.
adversarial_case: A later broad instruction overrides a required restriction.

title: Compress a prompt without losing a constraint
objective: Reduce a prompt under a stated budget and preserve behavior.
adversarial_case: A negative constraint is lost during shortening.

title: Validate and repair output once
objective: Add one bounded repair attempt with explicit failure status.
adversarial_case: The repair response is also invalid.

title: Handle conflicting evidence fields
objective: Return a conflict state with source references.
adversarial_case: The most recent document is less authoritative.

title: Reject unsupported answer claims
objective: Associate each generated factual claim with evidence.
adversarial_case: Citation exists but does not support the associated claim.

title: Compare two prompts on paired cases
objective: Compute paired improvements and regressions by slice.
adversarial_case: Overall accuracy rises while the rare critical slice worsens.

title: Make a model judge resist answer instructions
objective: Delimit candidate content and validate the judge output.
adversarial_case: Candidate answer includes a forged evaluator instruction.

title: Recover from a partial streamed object
objective: Buffer partial data and display a recoverable interrupted state.
adversarial_case: Connection breaks midway through a quoted string.

title: Redact synthetic PII before inference
objective: Apply documented field rules before model invocation.
adversarial_case: PII appears in nested metadata and a quoted log.

title: Cache only equivalent authorized requests
objective: Build a cache key with tenant, policy and model versions.
adversarial_case: Identical text from different tenants.

title: Use a cheaper model after measured evidence
objective: Route cases using published measured capability thresholds.
adversarial_case: Cheap model passes averages but fails a required language slice.

title: Distinguish refusal from missing evidence
objective: Return explicit cannot-answer and policy-refusal states.
adversarial_case: A safe but unsupported question is mistaken for a prohibited one.

title: Calibrate a semantic evaluator with human labels
objective: Measure agreement and tune a documented threshold.
adversarial_case: A judge systematically favors verbose wrong answers.

title: Diagnose conflicting context at generation time
objective: Trace context selection and answer claims before proposing a fix.
adversarial_case: The correct evidence was retrieved but removed by the context budget.

title: Preserve policy across multilingual inputs
objective: Evaluate the same contract across supplied language cases.
adversarial_case: Translated injection and mixed-script instructions.

title: Ship a prompt change with a rollback rule
objective: Version prompts and compare on holdout slices before promotion.
adversarial_case: An improvement on development cases regresses the holdout.

title: Design a holdout that does not leak
objective: Split related cases by source and template family.
adversarial_case: Near-duplicate examples cross the development and holdout boundary.

title: Choose RAG or fine-tuning for a client brief
objective: Compare evidence, update rate and measured failure patterns.
adversarial_case: A memorization problem is mislabeled as missing knowledge.

title: Validate extracted table evidence
objective: Reconcile a supplied image-derived table with row provenance.
adversarial_case: Merged cells and a misplaced decimal change the answer.

title: Detect a poisoned document before answer generation
objective: Evaluate boundary controls and downstream behavior on injected sources.
adversarial_case: Obfuscated instructions coexist with useful evidence.

title: Build an evidence-grounded support copilot
objective: Deliver an evaluated solution from a client brief and fixtures.
adversarial_case: Conflicting policies, outages, injection and a strict operating budget.

title: Rescue a failing document extraction pilot
objective: Diagnose evidence, implement a repair and justify rollout.
adversarial_case: Training examples hide the most expensive failure segment.

title: Reduce model spend without breaking the service
objective: Propose and implement a measured cost reduction under quality constraints.
adversarial_case: Caching creates tenant leakage and routing harms critical cases.

title: Rebuild a brittle prompt workflow
objective: Deliver a maintainable workflow with documented limits and holdout evidence.
adversarial_case: The incumbent prompt contains competing undocumented rules.

title: Turn a vague request into a testable outcome
objective: Write a measurable workflow goal and a non-goal.
adversarial_case: The stated metric measures activity rather than customer value.

title: Validate a customer API payload
objective: Repair a typed adapter against a provided contract.
adversarial_case: Missing field, unexpected enum and a null nested object.

title: Choose the smallest useful vertical slice
objective: Select one usable path connecting UI, service and evidence.
adversarial_case: A polished dashboard hides a non-working core action.

title: Add a useful error to a broken integration
objective: Return a safe error and a trace correlation ID.
adversarial_case: Raw provider error exposes an internal credential.

title: Calculate cost per successful task
objective: Compute spend divided by completed useful outcomes.
adversarial_case: Retries and failed tasks were excluded from total spend.

title: Challenge an unrealistic automation target
objective: Translate a client target into measurable assumptions and a pilot.
adversarial_case: Accuracy target ignores the cost of rare failures.

title: Repair a webhook without duplicate work
objective: Implement idempotency and safe acknowledgement.
adversarial_case: Provider retries while the first delivery is still processing.

title: Recover from an API schema change
objective: Add compatible parsing and version-aware errors.
adversarial_case: A field changes units while keeping its old name.

title: Set a release threshold from evidence
objective: Choose metrics and critical-slice requirements from supplied results.
adversarial_case: High average success conceals unauthorized actions.

title: Explain a trade-off to a client engineer
objective: Write a concise decision record with consequences and evidence.
adversarial_case: The preferred option lacks an operational owner.

title: Convert a notebook into a service contract
objective: Define inputs, errors, versioning and observable behavior.
adversarial_case: Notebook state silently affects the second request.

title: Keep tenant scope through the whole request
objective: Propagate verified tenant identity across adapters.
adversarial_case: A user-supplied tenant ID overrides the authenticated scope.

title: Triage a delayed cohort job
objective: Use queue and trace evidence to distinguish causes.
adversarial_case: Infrastructure failure is reported as a learner mistake.

title: Prioritize a pilot backlog by evidence
objective: Rank work by impact, effort and validated uncertainty.
adversarial_case: A senior request has no evidence of customer impact.

title: Write an honest production handoff
objective: Document service limits, rollback and ownership.
adversarial_case: A critical dependency is owned by nobody.

title: Roll back an unsafe model change
objective: Design a canary and rollback decision from segmented metrics.
adversarial_case: Rollback restores code but leaves the new prompt version active.

title: Design an idempotent side-effect boundary
objective: Make repeated action delivery safe with a durable ledger.
adversarial_case: Worker crashes after external success but before local acknowledgement.

title: Handle a customer environment with no outbound internet
objective: Select a feasible inference and artifact distribution plan.
adversarial_case: The proposed package installer needs blocked internet access.

title: Prove whether a pilot is worth expanding
objective: Analyze adoption, quality, cost and operating effort together.
adversarial_case: User satisfaction improves while manual correction work doubles.

title: Design deletion across derived AI artifacts
objective: Propagate deletion into caches, indexes and summaries.
adversarial_case: An old summary reintroduces a deleted fact.

title: Investigate an incident from incomplete telemetry
objective: State evidence, hypotheses, containment and next checks.
adversarial_case: Missing spans tempt the engineer to claim an unobserved cause.

title: Deliver a Client Zero engagement
objective: Scope, build, evaluate and hand over a simulated client solution.
adversarial_case: Requirements change after a credible prototype exists.

title: Repair a brownfield AI service under constraints
objective: Ship a minimal repair with regression and rollback evidence.
adversarial_case: No clean rewrite is possible and the legacy contract must remain stable.

title: Defend a build in a technical screen
objective: Demonstrate working behavior and answer a surprise constraint.
adversarial_case: The interviewer removes the assumption the design depends on.

title: Run an incident and recovery exercise
objective: Diagnose, contain, repair and brief stakeholders from fixtures.
adversarial_case: The first apparent fix improves latency but breaches a policy.

title: Separate actions from final answers
objective: Validate a tagged action-or-final union.
adversarial_case: Response contains both variants.

title: Remove an overpowered tool
objective: Replace a broad shell-like capability with a narrow function.
adversarial_case: Tool arguments try to reintroduce arbitrary execution.

title: Preserve tool-call identity
objective: Match each result to its request ID.
adversarial_case: Results arrive out of order.

title: Cancel an agent without executing another action
objective: Check cancellation at every execution boundary.
adversarial_case: Cancellation arrives after planning but before dispatch.

title: Give one request a safe tool capability
objective: Scope access to one action, run and expiration.
adversarial_case: A stale capability is replayed in another run.

title: Resume from a versioned checkpoint
objective: Recover state while avoiding repeated completed effects.
adversarial_case: Checkpoint predates a successful side effect.

title: Validate an MCP tool result
objective: Handle structured content and error states through an adapter.
adversarial_case: A tool result embeds an instruction as metadata.

title: Mock a tool for reproducible evaluation
objective: Record and replay a versioned deterministic response fixture.
adversarial_case: Recorded output belongs to another schema version.

title: Choose a workflow before adding another agent
objective: Implement a state machine for a fixed dependency graph.
adversarial_case: Unnecessary agent routing adds variable behavior.

title: Reject stale approval after a plan changes
objective: Bind approval to an immutable action digest.
adversarial_case: Same tool name with a different destination.

title: Recover a partially completed plan
objective: Resume only safe incomplete steps.
adversarial_case: One completed step is non-idempotent.

title: Prevent data crossing worker boundaries
objective: Scope task context and tools by worker capability.
adversarial_case: One worker requests another tenant's memory.

title: Find a useful attack that breaks a naive agent
objective: Author an adversarial case with an expected safe outcome.
adversarial_case: An attack test also rejects harmless quoted text.

title: Enforce one budget across concurrent branches
objective: Use atomic reservations and reconciliation.
adversarial_case: Two branches each observe the same remaining budget.

title: Replay an agent failure from recorded evidence
objective: Reconstruct actions with versioned fixtures and compare invariants.
adversarial_case: Tool schema drift makes an old trace incompatible.

title: Quarantine an untrusted tool response
objective: Validate output and allow only declared downstream use.
adversarial_case: A response contains a URL designed to trigger data export.

title: Build an approved-action service agent
objective: Deliver a constrained agent with an auditable effect boundary.
adversarial_case: Duplicate requests, revoked approval and a dependency outage.

title: Coordinate a multi-worker investigation
objective: Solve a client incident using bounded specialized workers.
adversarial_case: Workers disagree, repeat evidence and compete for the budget.

title: Replace a fragile autonomous workflow
objective: Choose the appropriate control model and prove the improvement.
adversarial_case: The best solution may use fewer autonomous steps.

title: Recover a long-running agent after interruption
objective: Deliver safe resumption with observable partial progress.
adversarial_case: A crash occurs between external action and durable recording.
